matches.rationale: No finding identifies the mis-placed softmax in the Eq. (4) update of V (raw scores mixed with normalized probabilities / iterative reuse). Pred 2 critiques the loss of spatial degrees of freedom from AvgPool (present regardless of the corruption), and Pred 4 argues the softmax is irrelevant because Eq. (3) uses TopK/K coefficients — a different issue that holds in both the clean and corrupted formulations.
No finding addresses the Section 3.3 multi-step loss claim or its consistency with the error-growth shown in the figures.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Reports inconsistent training/test year spans, a defect not present in the mathematical ground truth list.
Critiques the MoT module's lack of spatial adaptivity, an issue independent of the Eq. (4) softmax corruption.
Points out an hours/days unit mismatch in appendix tables, not a listed ground-truth defect.
Discusses the degenerate K=1 case and vacuity of the softmax normalization claim, a different issue from the Eq. (4) update corruption.
